edition_title: The dome became the best seat
subject: The dome is now the most valuable seat in entertainment

hero.statement: The dome became the most valuable seat in entertainment
hero.sub: The screen grew a ceiling, and the money followed. Sphere and Cosm turned the wraparound dome into the format everyone is racing to build.

sections.statement: Sphere became the top grossing venue on earth
sections.body: Billboard and Pollstar ranked the Las Vegas Sphere the top grossing venue in the world for 2025. The Wizard of Oz at Sphere has sold more than 2 million tickets and 260 million dollars since its 2025 debut. One room, wall to wall image, and a line out the door.
sections.why: When a single immersive room outsells arenas, immersive stops being a novelty and becomes a business model.

sections.statement: The dome is going global and getting company
sections.body: Sphere is advancing a 1.7 billion dollar venue on Yas Island in Abu Dhabi and a smaller one at National Harbor in Maryland. Meanwhile Sony is investing 100 million dollars in Cosm, which opens a fourth dome in Detroit this September and a fifth in Cleveland after that.
sections.why: A format only spreads this fast when the audience keeps paying. The dome is being copied because it works.

sections.statement: The canvas is the product now
sections.body: What people buy a ticket for is not a band or a film. It is the surface itself, the feeling of standing inside the image. The venue is the content.
sections.why: If the room is the draw, the brands that own a moment inside it own attention money cannot buy elsewhere.

invitation.headline: Think in surfaces, not screens
invitation.body: You do not need a billion dollar dome to wrap a room. We design wraparound, real time environments at activation scale, white label, under your name.
